name: Simulacrum of Vhal Astra
summary: It grows with the crowd and, when it charges, calls a piece of it back from the Retire Zone.

face.name: Simulacrum of Vhal Astra

effect.text: This Entity has +1 Power for each other Human Entity on your Front.

recallFallen.text: Roll a d6: on 5–6 put a Human Entity from your Retire Zone onto your Front. That Entity attacks together with this Entity.

face.flavor: It is not him. It is the shape his people gave him.
